detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Cardiogen

Chemical Information:
  • Amino Acid Sequence: Glu–Asp–Arg (EDR)
  • Peptide Length: Tripeptide
  • Molecular Formula: C₁₅H₂₆N₆O₈
  • Molecular Weight: ~418.41 g/mol
Structural Note:

Note: Cardiogen is a short-chain synthetic peptide. While its amino acid sequence is defined, molecular structure representations may vary depending on ionization state and visualization method. For this reason, a discrete molecular structure diagram is not shown. Molecular identity and purity are confirmed on a lot-specific basis in the accompanying Certificate of Analysis (CoA).

Description:

Cardiogen is a synthetic tripeptide composed of L-glutamic acid, L-aspartic acid, and L-arginine. It is supplied as a lyophilized powder and is intended for use exclusively in controlled in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals. As a low–molecular-weight peptide, Cardiogen is commonly utilized in experimental settings focused on peptide structure, stability, and interaction characteristics under controlled laboratory conditions. The product name is used for identification purposes only and does not imply any specific biological or therapeutic application.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro investigation of short regulatory peptide behavior in biochemical assay systems
  • Structural and stability analysis of tripeptide sequences
  • Comparative studies involving short peptide analogs in controlled laboratory environments
  • Analytical method development for low-molecular-weight synthetic peptides
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Maintain aseptic handling techniques to preserve product integrity
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

Cardiogen is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
